rows.title: New shares for US ADR offering (Nasdaq listing), KRW 40T
rows.detail: SK Hynix's US American Depositary Receipt offering and Nasdaq Global Select Market listing: up to 17,790,000 new common shares (177,900,000 ADSs) allotted to the ADR depositary Citibank, N.A. (third-party allotment, 제3자배정증자); use of proceeds: facilities KRW 40.0T as amended on 2026-07-10 (original filing: KRW 45.45T at the reference price of KRW 2,555,000 per share); overseas listing decision (해외증권시장주권등상장결정) filed 2026-06-24
